free_tier.stated: Free: 100 tasks/mo; unlimited Zap workflows, Tables and Forms; two-step Zap workflows; 15 min polling
free_tier.notes: A task is a successful Zap step; each programmatic call through Zapier MCP also uses tasks. Multi-step Zaps, webhooks, filters and paths are on Pro. Code steps get 1 second of included runtime per step on Free. The allowance resets monthly. New accounts get a 14-day Professional trial with no credit card.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the pages read

retention.stated: Zap history: a maximum of 60 days of Zap run data guaranteed, up to 10,000 runs displayed; Zap content and run metadata 7 days in logs and 29-69 days in the account

egress.terms: not applicable: actions call third-party apps; no traffic allowance is published

interface_detail: Zapier MCP takes the Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP only at one endpoint, with OAuth from the MCP client or a connection token; the TypeScript SDK and its CLI give programmatic access to 9,000+ app integrations. The interface vocabulary has no MCP or SDK term, so the list holds cli, which names the SDK CLI only.
tooling: an MCP client against Zapier MCP; the Zapier TypeScript SDK and its CLI
chaining: Moves data between hosted app accounts on a 15-minute poll within 100 tasks a month, so it fits low-volume glue between SaaS accounts, not a scheduler or a compute host.

limits.value: at most 60 days of Zap run data, up to 10,000 runs
2 tasks per successful Zapier MCP tool call, from the plan's task allowance; a failed call uses none
1 task per Zapier SDK action, fetch call or inbox-lease trigger outside Zapier, billed from December 1, 2026

limits_note: Free Zaps are two-step (one trigger, one action). Code steps get 1 second of included runtime per step on Free. Copilot has a daily message limit on Free.
binding_note: 100 tasks a month runs out first for any Zap that fires more than a few times a day.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for a work email, first name, last name and a password of at least 14 characters, or Google sign-in; the Professional trial needs no credit card. Whether an address at a public mail domain is accepted is unverified.

reliability_note: With pay-per-task billing off, usage stops at the task limit until the next cycle; the feature table lists pay-per-task billing for paid plans only.
confidence_note: Plan limits, retention and sign-up fields are read on first-party pages; a Zap run and an MCP call are not measured.
